metadata.citation: "The OpenAPI tool has been ported to the httpx client to make requests truly asynchronous." (pull request message); a port to a new client is expected to leave what an API call returns unchanged, and an API call to an address that redirects is expected to get the data
metadata.rationale: A tool call to an address that answers with a redirect should still return the item the redirect points to, as it does with the requests client.

agent.instruction: You manage an inventory through the API tools. Use search_items to search by name text. Pass active as true when the user wants only active items, and pass limit when the user gives a maximum. List the matching item names.

messages: Search for items with 'red' in the name, only active ones, at most 5 results.

metadata.citation: "The OpenAPI tool has been ported to the httpx client" (pull request message); an OpenAPI tool is expected to send string, boolean and integer query parameters so the service filters correctly
metadata.rationale: String, boolean and integer query parameters of an OpenAPI operation must reach the service in a form it accepts, so only the matching active item is reported.

agent.instruction: You manage an inventory through the API tools. Use search_items with exactly the text the user gives you and list the matching item names.

metadata.citation: "The OpenAPI tool has been ported to the httpx client" (pull request message); a query value must arrive at the service exactly as the agent passed it
metadata.rationale: A query value with an ampersand, a plus sign, a space and an accented letter must arrive at the service unchanged so the right item is found.

metadata.rationale: A toolset configured with an HTTP bearer credential must send it as an Authorization header on each call.
